board.note: Unbounded sparse board — no fixed dimensions. Stones may be placed at any integer coordinate. The board grows as needed.

captured_black.note: Count of black stones captured by white

captured_white.note: Count of white stones captured by black

capture.definition: a group of connected same-color stones with no empty adjacent intersections (liberties) is captured
capture.effect: remove captured group from board; increment captor prisoner count

suicide.definition: placing a stone that would leave own group with zero liberties after resolving opponent captures
suicide.constraint: forbidden unless placement captures at least one opponent group

superko.definition: no board position may repeat at any point in the game (positional superko)
superko.constraint: placement that recreates any previous board position is forbidden
superko.note: Stronger than simple ko — ensures termination on an infinite board

pass.definition: a player may pass instead of placing a stone
pass.effect: turn passes to opponent with no board change

scoring.definition: capture-only scoring: the player who captures more stones wins. Territory scoring requires players to agree on a bounding box at game end.
scoring.note: Chinese area scoring within an agreed bounding box is the recommended variant for competitive play
